title: Amazon to acquire DuckLabs, adding the team behind DuckDB amid broader shakeup in cloud data

title: Bafang’s new electric bike motors produce 8x your own pedaling power
snippet: Bafang has never exactly been known for building timid e-bike motors, but its latest pair of high-performance e-MTB drives takes things to a whole new level. We’re talking up to 1,700 watts of peak power, 150 Nm of torque, and 800% pedal assistance. At that point, “pedal assist” is starting to do some pretty heavy lifting as a phrase.

title: How Tesla’s solar business works in 2026 after killing Solar Roof
snippet: Tesla’s residential solar business has been shrinking for most of a decade, ever since the company absorbed SolarCity in 2016.
